title: Refunds for card payments

rules.text: A customer can ask for a refund only within 30 days of the payment.
rules.met: An order paid 31 days ago gets 422 REFUND_WINDOW_CLOSED, and nothing is saved.

examples.when: the customer asks for a refund
examples.then: the refund is saved as pending

examples.when: the customer asks for a refund
examples.then: they see "Too late to refund" and nothing is saved

rules.text: The customer sees the refund as pending right away.
rules.met: POST /refunds answers 201 with status PENDING before the card provider is called.

examples.then: the order page shows "Refund pending" at once

rules.text: A support agent can cancel a refund only while it is pending.
rules.met: Cancelling a refund that was already sent gets 409 REFUND_ALREADY_SENT.

examples.then: its status is CANCELLED and the job skips it

examples.given: a refund already sent to the card provider

rules.text: The customer gets one email when the refund is done.
rules.met: A refund.done event sent twice gives one email.

examples.given: a refund the card provider accepted
examples.then: the customer gets one email "Your refund is on its way"

folders.why: one folder per area, next to orders and payouts

style: Order and payment endpoints return errors as ApiError(code, message).
Jobs run with @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 60_000) and retry with retry.run, 5 tries.
do_not: No `ProblemDetail` in refunds: only payouts use it, and choice 2 picked ApiError.
Never send an event straight out: write it with EventPublisher (ADR 1, events go through the outbox).
No new retry or HTTP helper: use retry.run and CardClient.

style: OrderPage is a class component. Keep it one.
do_not: No hooks in OrderPage (`useState`, `useEffect`): it is a class component.
Do not call the mail provider directly (`smtp`): use sendEmail.

journeys.title: Customer gets a refund
journeys.data: Test customer cust-01 with order 1042, paid 3 days ago, 20.00, in staging.

steps.do: Sign in as cust-01 and open order 1042.
Wait for the refund job (at most a minute).
Open the test mailbox for cust-01.
steps.see: One email: "Your refund is on its way".

checks.title: Support tool times out after 5 seconds
steps: In staging, slow payments-api down with the test delay flag.
Cancel a pending refund in the support tool.
See the timeout message after 5 seconds, and the refund still PENDING.
